name: Alex Roeser
headline: Embedded systems, PCB design & firmware
about: I build electronics end to end: schematic capture and board layout in KiCad, bring-up, and the firmware that makes each board useful, on AVR, RP2040 and Arduino platforms.
Around the hardware I write the tools that make it easier to work with, from Python hosts that talk to microcontrollers over serial to browser scripts that make a busy makerspace easier to run.
